pkgmetadata.longdescription: Carla is a fully-featured modular audio plugin host, with support for many audio drivers and plugin formats. This ebuild builds only the audio engine, LV2/VST plugin-hosting backend and command-line/bridge tools; the standalone Qt/Python GUI frontend cannot currently be built because it requires dev-python/pyqt5, which has been removed from the Gentoo ebuild repository (and is not provided by any overlay configured on this system). Carla remains usable headless and as an LV2 plugin inside another host (e.g. a DAW) without the GUI.
